scope: Active infusion sessions and their current pump records
classifications: Immediate removal: repeated unresolved dose-rate discrepancies with a maintenance test showing output error greater than 10 percent, or delivered settings exceeding a drug hard limit.
Urgent inspection: repeated unresolved occlusion or pressure alarms without a confirmed dose-rate fault.
Routine follow-up: a resolved alarm with a passing maintenance check and current settings within drug limits.
Normal service: no unresolved alarm, settings within limits, and a passing maintenance check.
ranking_rules: Rank confirmed output and dose-rate faults above unresolved occlusion alarms, and unresolved alarms above resolved events.
Compare programmed dose, programmed rate, device-reported rate, drug hard limits, alarm recurrence, override status, and maintenance measurements.
Ward assignment is operational context and does not establish whether a pump is faulty.
clinical_boundary: This engineering review prioritizes equipment inspection and does not independently change medication orders or direct patient treatment.
